about: Ex Machinis playability objectives (#961). The one source of every objective's target band. Read by tools/balance/static_check.py (static objectives, in CI) and tools/balance/measure_live.py (live objectives, from the public API). Playtest objectives are scored in each round per DV-03. A 'guard' fails the build when broken; a 'target' is reported until it is met, then promoted to a guard. Change a band only through a tuning issue, per Procedures/SOPs/DV-03.

areas.onboarding: A newcomer's first company works, and every starter is a fair start
areas.ladder: Each step up the production chain pays, for specialists and for all-in-one makers
areas.growth: Growing a company is a choice between building and buying
areas.geography: The solar system has a shape: distance costs something, and going deeper pays for it
areas.capital: Money moves: markets are busy, capital works, the clock keeps up
areas.experience: Players have fun, find depth, and come back

objectives.title: Every starter matures in good time
objectives.metric: The slowest median game days to mature, over the unchanged Miner, Refiner and Maker startups in the startup race

objectives.title: No starter is a trap
objectives.metric: The slowest starter's median days to mature over the fastest's

objectives.title: A newcomer's first company works
objectives.metric: Share of newcomer personas whose first company is gaining within one real hour

objectives.title: Mining pays a living
objectives.metric: Credits a tool-hour for the best near mineral mined and refined at the Moon and sold to the Moon Depot, after sales tax and fuel

objectives.title: Making things pays more than mining
objectives.metric: The lower of the tier 3 and tier 4 median credits a tool-hour (made all the way from refined goods bought from the House), over the mining baseline

objectives.title: Each tier pays more than the one below
objectives.metric: The smallest ratio of a tier's median credits a tool-hour to the tier below (tiers 2 to 4)

objectives.title: Specialists can trade
objectives.metric: The lowest tier median (tiers 2 to 4) of credits a tool-hour for buying a recipe's inputs from the House, making one step and selling to the House

objectives.title: Every made good has a buyer
objectives.metric: Goods of tiers 2 to 4 that a recipe makes but no exchange buys

objectives.title: No free loops
objectives.metric: Goods an exchange buys for at least what it or another exchange sells them for, plus kits whose parts the House buys for more than 80% of the kit

objectives.title: Equipment is worth building
objectives.metric: The highest ratio, over the kits' modules, of what a module's materials and fuel cost (from refined goods bought from the House) to the House's price for it

objectives.title: Ships are worth building
objectives.metric: What a Mining Cruiser's materials and fuel cost to build over the House's price for the hull

objectives.title: The map has a shape
objectives.metric: The richest place's abundance over the poorest's, for minerals found near Earth and Mars (far homes left out)

objectives.title: Distance has a price
objectives.metric: Fuel for a trip from Earth to Neptune over fuel for a trip from Earth to the Moon

objectives.title: The frontier pays for the trip
objectives.metric: Credits a game hour for a Cruiser that mines the best far mineral at a far home near Jupiter, fills its hold and hauls it back, over the mining baseline

objectives.title: Players go beyond Mars
objectives.metric: Share of players' working drones beyond the Earth and Mars systems and the inner planets

objectives.title: No one place holds everyone
objectives.metric: Share of players' working drones at the busiest place

objectives.title: Capital is at work
objectives.metric: Share of matured companies' holdings that is idle credits (dashboard capital tile)

objectives.title: Investing pays, but not too easily
objectives.metric: Matured companies' profit over 30 game days against their cash-out value (dashboard capital tile)

objectives.title: The market is busy
objectives.metric: Trades on the last full game day against the norm (dashboard banner ratio)

objectives.title: The clock keeps up
objectives.metric: Real seconds a game day now over the target

objectives.title: It's fun
objectives.metric: Newcomer personas' median rating for fun, out of 10

objectives.title: It has depth
objectives.metric: Newcomer personas' median rating for depth, out of 10

objectives.title: Players come back
objectives.metric: Newcomer personas' median rating for 'would play again', out of 10

objectives.title: There's more than one way to win
objectives.metric: Distinct strategies (mining, making, trading, hauling, salvage, investing) among the round's five most profitable companies
